coder_notes: Population includes IDH-mutant astrocytoma, IDH-wildtype GBM and brain metastases from many solid tumours; coded basket_gbm_eligible (multi-cancer) though mixed_glioma_gbm_named could also apply - both include. GBM patients receive NEO212 alone (Phase 1 and Phase 2b glioma arm) -> regimen coded monotherapy for the GBM-relevant arm; brain-metastasis arms combine NEO212 with SOC regimens the patients are already receiving (C3 soc_backbone). NEO212 is a TMZ-perillyl alcohol conjugate described as a novel chemical entity (formulation_flag none; could be argued prodrug). FOLFIRI split into components; 'Zaltrap' (aflibercept) given as other name and the 4 mg/kg dose matches aflibercept, so listed with uncertainty about whether it is actually given. PD-L1/MSI/EGFR/ALK mentions are label-indication criteria for brain-metastasis SOC arms, not matched to the candidate. IDH row is a cohort-defining entry requirement (IDH-mutant or IDH-wildtype), not candidate-matched. Phase 1 GBM patients are not in a separately labelled arm. PK sample type not stated.
